value.rationale: The natural ancestry poset signature contains all transitive comparisons, so generic undirected-tree identification does not directly resolve its two-variable expressivity. The theorem supplies a uniform quantifier-rank bound depending on height rather than cardinality, and the complete automorphism-orbit refinement on a branching-unbounded family. The six-vertex acyclic obstruction is the exact finite boundary where the poset promise becomes essential, and the seven-vertex rank-two pair demonstrates a necessary higher-rank phenomenon for height two. These are motivated structural distinctions, not a bare code census.
